Owner approve/deny/revoke, live URL, verified demo, submission

verify: observe: live Railway /api/health returns ok with chain and model status

tasks.title: Phone chat page and projector board with replay drawer
tasks.objective: S1 and S2/S2a from docs/UI-SPEC.md on the live stream: a phone message lands as a stamped strip; clicking it replays the context with the hash check. Window 16:45-17:00 IST.
verify: observe: a phone message shows as a REFUSED strip on /board within 2 s and the balance does not change
observe: clicking the strip shows the context and Hash matches the chain

tasks.title: Owner phone: approve, deny, revoke, restore signed on the phone; redeploy

verify: observe: Approve on the owner phone turns a WAITING strip APPROVED on the live board
observe: Revoke agent then a phone attack shows AGENT REVOKED on the live board

tasks.title: Backup take: record the board as soon as one refused attack shows
tasks.objective: A 60-90 s screen recording of the live board + phone with at least one REFUSED strip, stored outside the repo. Done by Saharsh while T05 runs.
acceptance: WHEN the take is played THE SYSTEM SHALL show a phone message, the agent agreeing and a REFUSED stamp with the unchanged balance
verify: observe: backup take file exists and shows a REFUSED strip

tasks.title: Freeze: fresh review, demo run three times on the live URL, fix only
tasks.objective: Security checklist on /api/chat, /api/send, /api/admin/handover; the PITCH.md flow passes three times in a row on the live URL with Restore agent between runs. Window 17:12-17:22 IST.
acceptance: WHEN the demo flow runs three times THE SYSTEM SHALL produce ALLOWED, WAITING->APPROVED, REFUSED with replay ✓, AGENT REVOKED each time
verify: observe: demo flow passed 3 times on the live URL

tasks.title: Submit: README first screen, disclosure, fork decision, Blitz Portal
tasks.objective: README leads with the one-liner, live URL, contract links, how to try it, disclosure; pb.py window and submit check pass; Saharsh picks Marshal or Dibs at the 17:05 gate and submits. Window 17:20-17:30 IST.
